intro: ELIXIR-UK is the UK Node of ELIXIR, Europe’s infrastructure for bioscience research data objects. We bring together research organisations across the UK and the people who make those objects FAIR.

mission.title: People
mission.text: Communities of practice, fellowships, training and careers for data professionals.

mission.title: Services
mission.text: Endorsed open-access services and the support behind them.

mission.title: AI-readiness
mission.text: FAIR, well-described research data objects that AI and machine learning can use.

mission.title: Sustainable infrastructures
mission.text: Long-term funding, membership and shared capacity across UK research organisations.
